verdict.rationale: Supabase documents choosing a project region at creation ([supabase-docs-23]) and Read Replicas explicitly for improving latency by placing data closer to users worldwide ([supabase-docs-21],[supabase-docs-39]), plus globally distributed Edge Functions near users ([supabase-docs-29]). This directly covers region selection and read replicas for low-latency global reads. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of replica latency improvements and no detail on cross-region write/multi-primary strategies.
